description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git's logging and commit graph functionalities, including Bloom filters, commit graph writing, and error handling. It uses a testing framework to automate verification of Git's internal behavior related to commit graphs, filters, and merge behavior.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: A helper function that reads the graph data and verifies the bloom chunks and related metadata.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository, creates commits, and generates a commit graph with Bloom filters.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_used
methods.description: Tests whether Bloom filters are used during Git log for given arguments.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_not_used
methods.description: Tests whether Bloom filters are not used during Git log for given arguments.

methods.name: get_first_changed_path_filter
methods.description: Reads the first bloom filter for changed paths from the commit graph.

methods.name: check_corrupt_graph
methods.description: Checks if a corrupted commit graph triggers appropriate warnings and errors.
